argv: bundle exec overcommit --install && bundle exec overcommit --sign
commands.label: declared-shell-hooks

scope: Seven selected guarded updater/commit/final-HEAD-lock paths, caller shells/hooks, shared cache and local Git race

steps.name: Configure git author
steps.script:
git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

steps.name: Update nixpkgs
steps.script:
before=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
./utils/update-nixpkgs.sh
after=$(git rev-parse HEAD)

if [ "$before" != "$after" ]; then
  echo "committed=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
else
  echo "committed=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
fi

steps.name: Push update
steps.script:
final_lock="$RUNNER_TEMP/flake-update-final.lock"
git show HEAD:flake.lock > "$final_lock"
nix shell "$CONFCTL_FLAKE" -c confctl inputs check-update \
  --old-lock "$UPDATE_OLD_LOCK" --new-lock "$final_lock"
